svg.title: Rina and Jonah: original and expression variants
svg.desc: Rina tries an amused expression. Jonah tries a dry half-smile. Each is compared with the original features on the same body pose.
svg.text: Original likenesses. Different reactions. The same reusable sources as page 1.
Softer eyes and brows; a small closed-mouth smile.
One raised brow and an uneven half-smile.
PRIVATE EXPRESSION STUDY / HEADS, HAIR, NECKS, AND BODY POSES RETAINED
